headline: World Series Game 5: Brewers @ Rays, 5:00 PM PT on FOX. Milwaukee leads 3-1 after Tampa won Game 4 in 12 innings. Misiorowski starts for the Brewers. Plus NBA and NHL. WNBA Finals Game 6 is Thursday.

record.label: Yesterday (Tue 10/27)
record.note: A bad night. The Rays rallied in the 12th to win 4-3, beating the Brewers ML and the SGP. Hellebuyck shut down the Stars in his Devils debut, and Blue Jackets-Flyers went to OT over the total. Only the Panthers (5-1) hit. The Contreras prop couldn't be confirmed.

notes: The board is down about 4 units overall after two losing days. Today's card is short on purpose.
No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning.
Bet only what you can afford to lose. Help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edge on today's card. Tuesday these went 1-3. One main play today: the best starter in baseball against a worn-out Rays staff.

straight.reasoning: SI and TheSpread both pick Milwaukee. Misiorowski led the majors with a 1.80 ERA and 252 strikeouts, is on full rest, and allowed one run over five innings against Tampa in Game 1. The Rays have no rested starter after a 12-inning Game 4, so it's Rasmussen on three days' rest or another bullpen game. The line has moved from -128 to -155 in Milwaukee's favor. Risk: Milwaukee's bullpen also worked deep Tuesday. Prices range from -141 to -155; playable to -155.
FanDuel Research and Dimers' model both like Philly. The 76ers are 3-1, while Indiana is 1-3 against the spread and without Zubac. Skip at -5.5.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: World Series Game 5: Brewers @ Rays, 5:00 PM PT on FOX. Milwaukee leads 3-1. Misiorowski (1.80 ERA) vs Rasmussen on short rest or a Rays bullpen game. Brewers -141 to -155, total 6.5 (no clear lean). If Tampa wins, Game 6 is Friday in Milwaukee.

straight.reasoning: An ace on full rest against a taxed Rays staff. Two sources agree. Playable to -155.

props.reasoning: He's allowed 4+ hits in all three playoff starts (13 hits in 13.1 innings) against a contact-heavy Rays lineup, and SI expects a longer leash in a clinch game. A quarter unit, since it pulls slightly against the Brewers bet.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: NBA Wednesday (12 games): 76ers @ Pacers and Hornets @ Pistons (4:00 PM PT), Knicks @ Bulls (5:00), Thunder @ Mavericks (6:30), and more. It's still early in the season, so these are small bets, with the most weight on the one pick two sources agree on. WNBA Finals Game 6 is Thursday in Atlanta; the Valkyries lead 3-2.

straight.reasoning: FanDuel Research takes Philly -4.5, and Dimers' model gives the 76ers a 66% chance to win. Philadelphia is 3-1, while Indiana is 1-3 against the spread and without Ivica Zubac (ankle). Laying under five on the road is a manageable number. Skip at -5.5.

The Knicks are 1-3 straight up and against the spread, and they're on the second night of a back-to-back after hosting Detroit Tuesday. Chicago had Tuesday off. 7.5 points at home is a lot. FanDuel Research's pick.
Charlotte has gone Under in all four games and been held under 105 twice without Kon Knueppel. Detroit is on the second night of a back-to-back. FanDuel Research's pick.

OKC is 4-0 but missing Chet Holmgren, Alex Caruso and Jalen Williams, with Ajay Mitchell questionable. Dallas already has road wins at Indiana and Miami, and Kyrie just played a season-high 33 minutes. FTN's model shows an edge on Dallas, and FanDuel Research expects a low-scoring game, which also helps the underdog.

props.reasoning: With Zubac out, there are more boards to go around. Haliburton had 4 and 6 rebounds on 10 chances each in his last two games, and Philly allows the third-most rebounds to guards. FTN's model projects 6.1. Quarter unit.
